tool_config.name: find_duplicates
tool_config.description: Check whether a new need duplicates one of the calling Foreman's open Requests: same Job and same Category, not Resolved. Call it for each new need once find_jobs has matched its Job and you know its Category, before the read-back. Returns the duplicates newest first as [{"ref": "R-1042", "job": "Route 104 Widening", "category": "Trucking", "need": "tri-axle dump trucks", "quantity": 3, "unit": "trucks", "needed_by": "Monday, November 2 at 7:00 AM", "recorded_at": "Saturday, October 31 at 6:45 AM"}]. recorded_at is when the Foreman made that Request. An empty list [] means it duplicates none. Writes nothing. Returns {"error": "..."} if the check could not be done.

request_body_schema.description: The new need's Job and Category. Do not call it for an Unmatched Job.

job_id.description: The job_id find_jobs returned for the Job of the new need, once it is the one Job the Foreman means.

category.description: The Category of the new need.
